request.style: English, children's sing-along, cheerful male lead vocal with kids choir, ukulele, xylophone, hand claps, tuba bass, playful percussion, bouncy and fun, 116 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Noah built a great big boat
Cypress wood and pitch to coat
Three decks high, a door in the side
God said, Noah, come inside

[Chorus]
Two by two, two by two
Birds that fly and bugs that crawl
Two by two, two by two
God took care of one and all
Flap your wings and stomp your feet
Two by two, two by two

[Verse]
Down came rain, the clouds were grey
Forty nights and forty days
Up went the water, deep and wide
Noah's family safe inside

[Chorus]
Two by two, two by two
Birds that fly and bugs that crawl
Two by two, two by two
God took care of one and all
Flap your wings and stomp your feet
Two by two, two by two

[Verse]
Noah opened up the window wide
Sent a little dove outside
Back she came with an olive leaf
Dry land coming, what a relief

[Bridge]
I have set my bow in the clouds
Red and orange, yellow, green and blue
Never again a flood, God said
That's a promise made to me and you

[Chorus]
Two by two, two by two
Birds that fly and bugs that crawl
Two by two, two by two
God took care of one and all
Flap your wings and stomp your feet
Two by two, two by two

[Outro]
Two by two, two by two
God took care of one and all
